primary.title: Claiming a deceased family member's mutual funds made less cumbersome: What SEBI has changed
primary.summary: SEBI has asked AMFI to simplify the industry's transmission norms, making it less cumbersome for nominees and legal heirs to claim rights on mutual funds after the investor's death. Here's what changed under the revised framework.
